name: Baltimore Aircoil Company, Inc.
old_description: BAC creates sustainable comfort cooling, process cooling, and refrigeration solutions for the most essential and demanding environments on earth.
about:
Baltimore Aircoil Company (BAC) is headquartered in Milford, Delaware, and traces its origins to 1938 when a single cooling coil was hand-built in a founder’s garage. The company has since evolved into an employee-owned enterprise, with its workforce of more than 2,000 global team members holding ownership stakes.

BAC designs and manufactures sustainable comfort cooling, process cooling, and refrigeration equipment for demanding environments. Its product portfolio includes evaporative condensers, adiabatic coolers such as the Trillium™ TRFS for large-scale data centers, modular hybrid coolers like the Nexus® line with integrated PuriStream™ water treatment, and a range of replacement parts supported by inspection services. The company operates globally, though specific facility sizes and production volumes are not disclosed.

The company serves a variety of industries, with explicit focus on heavy industrial and energy sectors. Recent project announcements highlight deployments in large-scale data centers, while its refrigeration piping manuals target industrial refrigeration system designers. Customers range from original equipment manufacturers to end-users seeking full-lifecycle support from initial selection through decades of operation.

BAC’s stated mission is to “continually advance truly sustainable cooling – inspired by nature, powered by our people.” The firm emphasizes balancing water and energy savings, a commitment dating to its first coil, and frames its differentiation around a coordinated, non-transactional process aimed at getting the solution right the first time and maintaining performance for decades. Core values include courage, innovation, responsibility, and trust.
